articles.summary: PARSIPPANY, N.J., Aug. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Embecta Corp. (“embecta”) (Nasdaq: EMBC), a global company that is advancing its 100-year legacy in insulin delivery to become a broad-based medical supplies company, today reported third quarter fiscal 2026 financial results.
articles.title: Embecta Corp. Reports Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Financial Results

articles.summary: PARSIPPANY, N.J., Aug. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Board of Directors of Embecta Corp. (“embecta”) (Nasdaq: EMBC) has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.01 for each issued and outstanding share of the Company’s common stock. The dividend is payable on September 15, 2026 to stockholders
articles.title: embecta Announces Quarterly Cash Dividend
